lanes.ruleset_requirement: Pinned scanner-specific public rules authored from the same already-frozen public vulnerability families, without reading cases, answers, scanner internals, or native-lane output.
lanes.reporting: Report this lane independently as capability-normalized methodology evidence.

prohibitions: never combine native and capability-normalized observations into one score denominator aggregate or rank
never choose or revise either ruleset after observing comparison cases or outputs
never treat the archived opengrep/opengrep-rules repository as implicitly current or recommended
never use adapter-conformance rules as a comparison ruleset
never infer missing evidence fields from rule names metadata messages or lane identity
